queries_run: 3M distribution channel shift go-to-market commercial excellence 2026
3M business model transition subscription OR platform OR e-commerce 2026

findings.claim: 3M 10-K FY2025 describes sales via direct-to-user plus e-commerce and traditional wholesalers, retailers, distributors and dealers; commercial excellence initiative aims to strengthen and optimize the go-to-market channel and partner engagement. No structural shift to subscription/D2C/platform stated.
findings.excerpt: As part of 3M's ongoing commercial excellence initiative, the Company is focused on further strengthening and optimizing this go‑to‑market channel, enhancing partner engagement, and improving overall channel performance to support continued growth.

channel_business_model_shift.note: Searches found no source on subscription/platform/D2C transition; Q2 2026 call material (nasdaq/marketbeat) mentions commercial excellence and cross-selling, and a holding-to-operating-company model plus shared services, not a channel structural change.

clues.claim: Q2 2026 call: commercial excellence, cross-selling pipeline and Safety & Industrial organic growth driven by channel engagement/new products
